svg.text: Weekly AI content-strategy brief. Next.js on Vercel, Supabase Postgres, Gemini Flash only, everything on free tiers.
What starts a run, and what the user sees
Web app (Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui)
Dashboard: 3-line headline, Signals panel (insight tiles + opportunity map), filterable and sortable theme cards, Generate now
Theme card: example videos with full stats, signal meters, cover maker (PNG download), editable draft script (auto-save)
Archive (list + detail) | Settings: categories, region, email, minimum views (Zod validated) | Light and dark mode
Each stage saves its result to the database, so a timeout never loses work
Supabase Postgres (database only), Drizzle ORM + postgres-js
Guardrails: Zod validation on every input and AI output, env validated at startup, secrets never logged, stale-brief fallback if YouTube or Gemini fails,
daily cache and quota guard, secret-protected cron, 204 automated tests plus a live smoke test.
